1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3 Nbd7 4.e4.strategy: Takes the full centre at once. With the knight already on d7, Black has no quick way to hit the e-pawn, and White's space advantage will last. Black has to counter with piece play and a well-timed pawn lever.

1.d4 Nf6 2.c4 d6 3.Nc3 Nbd7 4.e4 e5.strategy: Challenges the big centre immediately. The pawn is backed by d6 and by the knight, so Black keeps a compact and well-protected structure, accepting a little less space for a solid position without weaknesses.
